properties.description: CallerRule: Local (stdio, --shared, loopback --http; unchanged), TrustedGateway (--http-trusted-gateway / REFLOW2_TRUSTED_GATEWAY: the caller is the name the gateway puts on each call in _meta["reflow2/writes_for"]), Undeclared (served for others with nothing declared: nobody signs). It gives each call the reflow2_core::intent::Signer the store checks every signature against, the handshake note and the operator banner.
